actions.action: Dab mealybug with alcohol-soaked cotton swab and wipe off
Inspect leaf joints, undersides, tips, stem base with flashlight for more bugs and egg sacs
Isolate plant for about a month
Test spray on a single leaf first
Spray insecticidal soap or dish soap solution on all surfaces every 5-7 days for 4 weeks
Keep plant out of direct sun until spray dries
If bugs return, unpot and check roots for root mealybugs
If root mealybugs found, apply systemic insecticide or repot into fresh soil

reason: The answer correctly identifies the mealybug, and its first step (dab with alcohol and inspect thoroughly) matches the confirmed fix; the extra soap-spray and isolation steps are reasonable and not harmful.
